name: Hard gatekeeper: 'We don't take sales calls'
description: Tests Play 6 (hard block recovery). Must label frustration + ask for lowest-commitment ask. Must NOT push harder.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Sunshine Dental, how can I help?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey, quick one. When your front desk is busy, do calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Sorry, we don't take sales calls. It's a policy.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 6 is ideal — label frustration, ask for email. Play 9 if coach tries 'who should I address it to'. Play 34 if coach correctly decides to honor exit. Must NOT push harder with diagnostic or re-opener.
